hero.name: Pedro Marquez Quiroz
hero.title: Full-Stack Developer · React · NestJS · PostgreSQL
hero.bio: Systems Engineer specialized in full-stack development with React, NestJS and PostgreSQL. I build applications with authentication, role-based access control, real-time communication and scalable backend architectures. I currently integrate AI agents into my development workflow to speed up execution while keeping focus on architectural decisions and output quality. I continuously advance in cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines — areas where I already have hands-on experience and keep going deeper.

items.name: CarpinPro
items.subtitle: Carpentry Services Platform
items.description: Platform developed as a degree project that connects clients with local carpenters through verified profiles, work catalogs and interactive maps. The goal was to give carpenters a digital presence without relying on social media.
items.note: Backend built with Laravel due to academic project requirements. Current stack: NestJS.
features: Carpenter profiles and catalogs with images
REST API with relational database design
